artworks.description: The image shows various marine creatures on a sandy ocean floor. A large pinkish crab claw is in the foreground. Above it are several shrimp-like creatures, including a gray segmented one in the center, a pale pink one to the left, and another extending its antennae towards the middle. The color palette includes soft tans for the sand, blues for the water, and pinkish-gray tones for the crustaceans.

artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a crustacean at the top center, with three shells below it. The crustacean's body is pale beige with intricate details and long pink antennae. The color palette includes beige, brown, white, pink, red, and grey. The shells include a rounded, spotted one at the bottom left, an elongated spiral in the middle, and a small, rounded shell with a pink and grey pattern at the bottom right. The composition is enclosed within an oval frame.

The rocks are positioned behind the smaller objects and cover the top of the image, with some labeled numerically.

artworks.description: The image shows a group of marine animals, such as a large squid and octopus at the top left and center, a crab in the middle, and shells and crustaceans at the bottom. The color scheme includes natural tones like pink, brown, tan, and blue. The squid is on the left side, while the octopus is in the center with its tentacles spread out. In the water to the right, there is another sea creature with a pointed shell near the surface.

artworks.description: The image shows various marine life forms, sea creatures, and corals near a rocky formation by the sea. The creatures display a range of colors, such as purple, light blue, pink, beige, green, and orange. In the foreground, sea creatures are spread across a sandy shore. A rocky formation with corals and sea animals is on the right. The sea stretches from left to right, with a ship near the horizon and a large rock or cliff formation on the far left.

artworks.description: This is a painting of several aquatic life forms including insects and a snail. Seven different creatures are depicted against a light blue watery background. The style is akin to that of a naturalist artist, focusing on botanical or zoological accuracy. The delicate lines and detailed rendering of each creature highlight the study of their forms and textures, presented within an oval shape on an off-white background.

artworks.title: Plate 56: Water Scorpion, Water Measurer, Pond Skater, Red Water Mite, Leech(?), and Other Water Insects

artworks.description: The image features a large brown insect on the left, a similarly sized insect with an elongated body on the right, and a long, dark leech at the bottom. Additional smaller insects are scattered throughout, with two above the leech and two above the center. The color palette includes shades of brown, beige, light blue, and some red details. The background is light blue with wave-like patterns.

artworks.title: Plate 57: A Diving Beetle and Two Views of a Backswimmer
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This painting depicts three insects on a body of water. The insects, likely water beetles or water boatmen, are detailed and realistically portrayed on the water's surface. The central insect is larger and glossy with spread legs. The two smaller insects are also depicted with spread legs. There is a small object below the central insect. The background is a pale blue, suggesting a watery environment. The style resembles a scientific illustration or 18th-century naturalist artwork.

artworks.title: Plate 58: Shells, including Abalone(?)

artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)

artworks.description: The image consists of seven shell-like objects inside a large oval outline. The color palette includes earthy tones of grays, browns, soft blues, and whites. The objects are labeled from 1 to 7, with varying sizes and shapes.

artworks.title: Plate 5: Three Catfish, a Salmon, and Two Other Fish
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows several fish within an oval frame. The color palette includes shades of blue, brown, gray, and hints of pinkish-orange against a light blue background that represents water. In the upper part of the frame are the largest fish. In the upper left corner, a large brown catfish with barbels can be seen, with a darker catfish to the right. In the center, there is a spotted gray fish. Below, a pale fish with a red-tinged fin is slightly left of center, with a small golden fish to its right. At the bottom, a blue fish with a pronounced dorsal fin is positioned on both sides of the frame's curvature.

artworks.title: Plate 6: Five Catfish and Sturgeon(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various sea creatures in an oval composition. The image shows five different aquatic animals with distinct shapes and features swimming together in a body of water. The creatures exhibit detailed physical characteristics such as fins, scales, and spines along their backs. Each fish appears to be labeled by number. The water is rendered with subtle shading and texture, providing a sense of movement and depth within the confined space of the oval. The coloration and linework give the drawing a naturalistic and antique aesthetic.

artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows a smooth, continuous line forming an elongated oval shape on a plain background. There is a small "VII." near the edge of the oval.

artworks.title: Plate 8: A Dolphin, Two Seals, a Brethmechin, and Shells
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring various marine and coastal creatures in a semi-realistic style, akin to 16th to 17th-century naturalist illustrations. The image shows a collection of marine animals in a circular frame against a backdrop of water and a sandy shore. A dolphin is depicted in the upper left, a seal lounges nearby, a sea otter-like creature is below them, and a spined fish-like creature rests on the beach. Seashells are scattered across the sandy foreground, enhancing the naturalistic theme. The artwork is detailed, using lines and shading for depth and texture, blending real and fantastical elements in its depiction of marine life.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of decorative text. The artwork features ornate calligraphy surrounded by elaborate embellishments. The central text reads "ANIMALIA VOLATILIA ET AMPHIBIA," encased within a rectangular frame. Decorative elements include colorful flourishes, ribbons, and floral patterns. At the top, a blue and gold emblem with the word "AIER" is featured. Below, there is a smaller inscription, and at the bottom, additional Latin text is included. This is in the style of an illuminated manuscript or an ornately bordered page from a classical book.

artworks.title: Plate 9: Two Pheasants with Fruiting Plants

artworks.description: Two pheasants are in the image. One stands on the left with brown, red, and blue plumage, while the other is on the right drinking water. The color palette includes rich, earthy tones and vivid reds seen in the birds and berries on the bush behind them. The male pheasant is on the grassy and slightly rocky area to the left, while the female leans toward the water on the right. A tree with red berries sits between them.

artworks.title: Plate 10: Gray Crowned Crane and Helmeted Curassow
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)

artworks.description: Two birds are present in the image. One bird on the left is tall with a slender black body and a tufted crown, while the other bird on the right is shorter with a rounder body and a white crest on its head. In the background, there are greenish-brown trees with branches, leaves, and fruit. The color palette is mainly natural hues such as black, white, earth tones, red, and green. The tall bird is on the left side near the left tree, while the smaller bird is on the right side in front of the right tree. Both birds are situated on a grassy patch.

artworks.title: Plate 11: A Caucasian Grouse and a Helmeted Guineafowl
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)

artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds in a natural setting. It features two birds with dark feathers; one bird is pecking at the ground while the other stands upright with a speckled body and a colorful head. The background includes a small plant with a purple flower on the left and a palm tree on the right. The birds are depicted within an oval border, surrounded by inscriptions. The attention to detail in the feathers and the plant life is indicative of a naturalistic style.

artworks.title: Plate 12: Pair of Wood Grouse with a Melon and Pears

artworks.description: The image features two birds, one with a dark body and patterned tail on the left, and one with a brown body on the right, both situated on grass and earth. Above them, a branch extends from the right with two hanging green pears and a large, green-striped, oval-shaped fruit. The color palette includes shades of brown, green, yellow, and muted orange. The birds are positioned on the ground, with the darker bird standing upward on the left, while the brown bird leans forward on the right. The hanging fruits are located directly above the birds to the right.

The birds stand close to each other, centered under the branch, which forms a circular frame. Text and a Roman numeral, XIII, are present in the image.

The colors include shades of grey, pink, green, cream, and hints of yellow. The birds are on a ground with plants, and there is water in the background under a light blue sky. Various Latin inscriptions are above and below the frame.

artworks.title: Plate 16: Gray Heron and Purple Heron(?)  with a Sunflower

artworks.description: The image shows two heron-like birds facing each other beside a large sunflower, with additional flora. The birds are depicted within an oval border, one with blue-grey plumage on the left and one with a blend of blue and reddish tones on the right. Small flowers and green foliage are on the left side, while a coniferous tree with round pinecones is on the right. Latin inscriptions and the number XVI surround the image. It is styled similarly to traditional botanical and zoological illustrations, inspired by artists like Audubon.

The tree has a brown trunk and bright green, bushy foliage at the top. The color palette is dominated by natural shades of brown, green, and gray, with touches of red.
